# Upstream ICC test profiles

Unmodified test inputs from [moxcms master at 097dccf](https://github.com/awxkee/moxcms/tree/097dccf3a9ab40811f23baa5da71cbfb985f8de8/assets).
These retain their embedded profile notices, reproduced below; the library's
software license does not replace profile-specific notices.

`SM245B.icc` is also identified upstream as coming from
[skcms](https://skia.googlesource.com/skcms/+/refs/heads/main/profiles/misc/SM245B.icc).
`swapped_intent.icc` and `truncated_desc_v4.icc` are upstream's parser regression
fixtures, copied byte for byte. No benchmark photograph or unused profile is bundled.
